summary: Frontend-only bug fix validated on Admin -> Sécurité (/staff/admin/security). All 14 UI assertions passed on the preview sandbox. Manager login OK, both role cards (kitchen, phone) render, Save button is disabled while either password field is empty (aria-disabled=true) and enabled as soon as both fields have any content, live checklist (security-checks-<role>) shows the 6 rules incl. 'les deux champs identiques' as failing while confirm is empty, invalid-password click surfaces error toast citing the failing rule (e.g. '10 caractères min.'), mismatch click shows 'Les deux mots de passe ne correspondent pas', valid save shows 'Mot de passe enregistré – l'ancien code ne fonctionne plus' and badge flips to 'Mot de passe défini'. Kitchen re-login in a fresh context with the temporary password lands on /staff. page.keyboard.type(...) real key events on the phone fields also toggled the Save button to enabled and the save succeeded. Sandbox restored: kitchen = 'Preview-Cuisine-2026!', phone = 'Preview-Phone-2026!'. Manager password untouched. No production endpoint contacted. Note: 2 non-blocking React Native web warnings observed in console ('shadow*' style props deprecated; props.pointerEvents deprecated) – pre-existing, not related to this fix.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' – emitted on /staff/login and /staff/admin/security. Pre-existing, not caused by this fix but worth migrating to boxShadow. Reference: repeated across UI components.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' – emitted after save on security screen. Pre-existing.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to clear the RN web deprecation warning.
Optional: move props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents where it is still used (likely toast / overlay component).
critical_code_review_comments: security.tsx logic is correct: Save disabled only when either field is empty; both client-side rule check (with i18n error toast) and server-side validation kept; success adopts token when own password changed. Good UX.
seed_data_creation: Cleared staff_login_attempts collection once before login (was empty) to avoid the 429 lock; no other data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sandbox left with: manager='Preview-Manager-2026!', kitchen='Preview-Cuisine-2026!', phone='Preview-Phone-2026!'. Fix is confirmed working end-to-end from UI to backend PUT /api/auth/staff/password. Toast testID is 'toast'. Save button uses aria-disabled='true' when disabled and no attribute when enabled.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Save button stayed disabled even when both fields were filled with a matching valid password. Fix reviewed in /app/frontend/app/staff/admin/security.tsx line 99 – Button disabled prop now = !(pw.length) || !(confirm.length) instead of the previous stricter rule-based check. Client-side rules are still enforced inside save() (line 46-54) and displayed live via the RULES checklist (testID security-checks-<role>). Behaviour verified end-to-end for both kitchen and phone roles.
